newsitem.title: EGYPT: Christopher in Cairo for Mideast talks.
newsitem.headline: Christopher in Cairo for Mideast talks.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher arrived in Cairo on Monday to attend a Middle East conference and to discuss the peace process with Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat and Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy.

Christopher was due to meet Arafat, who is not attending the three-day conference, later on Monday and was scheduled to hold talks with Levy on Tuesday expected to focus on Israel's long-delayed troop redeployment from Hebron.
The outgoing U.S. secretary of state will also meet the European Union "troika" of foreign ministers from Ireland, the Netherlands and Italy on Tuesday.
